# Ollama published examples

`published_examples.json` copies the application/json 200 response examples from
Ollama's MIT-licensed published OpenAPI document, version 0.1.0:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ollama/ollama/main/docs/openapi.yaml

Pinned source SHA-256:
`d8e08be41dd858c933c32bef5ee8d0c5faf7d7462069a49b368731cfbceaab03`.

The balance test uses the official account balance example:
https://docs.ollama.com/api/balance

All credentials in the tests are synthetic. No live provider account is used.
